family: The single total language L of proof.md Part A: MOD3. For every integer n >= 0 and every x in {0,1}^n, f_n(x) = 1 iff the Hamming weight of x is congruent to 0 modulo 3. Thus f_0(empty) = 1 (empty sum 0), f_1 = 1 exactly on the all-zero string, and in general f_n is the characteristic function of the ternary residue of the weight. One fixed deterministic linear-time evaluator computes f_n at every length: scan the input, maintain the weight modulo 3, compare with 0. One fixed verifier accepts exactly the empty witness on yes-inputs.
theorem: For this one fixed total uniform polynomial-time family, which lies in P and hence in NP with empty witnesses, and whose circuits are required to compute f_n exactly on every input in the full Li-Yang B2 model, C_B2(f_n) >= 2n - 8 holds at every integer length n >= 4. Hence liminf over all integers n of C_B2(f_n)/n is at least 2, and for every epsilon > 0 the explicit threshold N_epsilon = max(4, ceil(8/epsilon)) makes C_B2(f_n) >= (2 - epsilon)*n hold for every integer n >= N_epsilon.
